content:
The **Fancy Single Action Revolver** is a non-automatic pistol in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wastelanders* update.

## Gameplay

An ornate weapon with a golden receiver, white grip, and a black barrel and cylinder with gold highlights. It has longer range along with a faster fire rate and reload speed compared to a fully-modded Single Action Revolver.

The weapon is equipped with a special receiver, barrel and grip, but can't use normal single action revolver mods. Unlike the Fancy Pump Action Shotgun, it does not have a set of guaranteed legendary effects. It may instead spawn with a randomly selected 1-★ Legendary effect if the player character is Level 25 or above.

## Locations

The fancy single action revolver has a 1.5% chance to be earned as a reward for turning in a Pleasant Valley Claim Ticket to the bellhop in the basement of the Pleasant Valley Ski Resort. Claim tickets are only available after completing the Key to the Past main quest.
